title: Kilauea Ep48 — 예보 창 개시 D-day (5/22~26), 10.5μrad 경사 ★업데이트
snippet: Kilauea summit inflation continues but interrupted by brief deflationary tilt starting yesterday ~5:30pm. Inflationary tilt at lower rate this morning. Uēkahuna tiltmeter tracked ~10.5 microradians since Ep47 ended May 15. Forecast: Episode 48 between Friday May 22 and Tuesday May 26. ADVISORY/YELLOW. Glow visible from both vents overnight, brighter at south vent. SO₂ 1,000-5,000 t/day.
tag_reason: 예보 창 D-day 진입 — 오늘부터 분수분출 가능. 경사계 10.5μrad. 어제 단기 수축 후 재팽창.
